entities.name: Jor Kadeen
entities.description: A leading member of the Mirran Resistance, a warrior and strategist, likely of Auriok descent, who pioneered hexgold.

entities.name: Mirran Resistance
entities.description: The resistance of Mirrans fighting Phyrexian rule of Mirrodin.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A healer who works closely with Jor Kadeen.

entities.name: Hexgold
entities.description: A substance refined from Glimmervoid plates and blinkmoth serum that protects against Phyrexianizing substances.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The overpowering enemy of the Mirrans.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The world the Resistance hopes to reclaim.

events.quote: Jor Kadeen pioneered the invention of hexgold
